race.comment: BRITISH GEM (3) continues to race well, and she was only denied in the final strides when runner-up as the favourite at Tamworth 8 weeks ago. She has since joined the Les Gordy stable, and a recent trial should have her spot on to give this a shake. Follow any positive market moves. PRAGUE PRIDE (7) has been heading the right way with her form this prep, collecting 2 placings from 4 starts, and she has since relocated from Victoria after a last start second at Pakenham-synthetic nearly 7 weeks ago. Hard to beat. IT'S SHOWTIME (4) backs up quickly after a solid third at Cairns just 9 days ago and the extra 460m here should not be an issue. Stick with him. ROTH AUTHORITY (10) showed improvement when finishing midfield here last start and is capable of taking another step forward. Include in all top 4 combos. OKAY ZOOMER (9) was narrowly beaten by a long neck at this track last time out, and his first win is not far away.
